episodes.title: The Anatomy of a Memory
episodes.summary: Diana Tyson was violently attacked on the university campus where Professor T has tenure. DI Lisa Donckers suspects that the assault is very similar to one that occurred years beforehand, and, having been a previous student of Professor T's, she thinks he can help.

episodes.title: A Fish Called Walter
episodes.summary: Professor T investigates the suspected poisoning of a librarian.

episodes.title: Tiger Tiger
episodes.summary: Professor T helps with a case involving the hit and run of a local jeweller.

episodes.title: Mother Love
episodes.summary: Professor T investigates a case involving a missing child.

episodes.title: Sophie Knows
episodes.summary: Professor T is approached by a family who claim that the police have the wrong suspect.

episodes.title: The Dutiful Child
episodes.summary: Professor T looks into the case of a shooting at the Cambridge Science Park.

episodes.title: Ring of Fire
episodes.summary: When a student is left badly burnt and in a coma after a house fire, the CID team overcome their reluctance to call in Professor T as it emerges that the victim was drugged, and the fire started deliberately.

episodes.title: The Mask Murders
episodes.summary: A prominent barrister and his second wife are found shot to death in a crime that has uncanny parallels to a double murder that he successfully prosecuted 15 years ago.

episodes.title: The Family
episodes.summary: When a palliative care doctor and her husband and two children are all found dead in a grisly tableau on their living room sofa, the Police ask Professor T to help them decipher how they died, in what order and at whose hands. Is it a text-book case of ‘familicide', in which one of the parents has murdered their partner and children or was a disgruntled third-party involved, given the doctor's outspoken support for assisted killing to let her patients die with dignity? As the investigation proceeds, Lisa is forced to confront the truth about her father's dementia and she finally shares it with Dan, bringing them closer together than ever. Challenged by Dr Helena to face his fears about his past, Professor T enlists help from Adelaide and Ms. Snares to confront his phobia of intimacy, but with extremely mixed results.

episodes.title: DNA of a Murderer
episodes.summary: When an artisan baker is found dead after receiving death threats, the police appear to have an open and shut case against the son of a convicted murderer who was sent to prison thanks to the baker's testimony.

episodes.title: The Trial
episodes.summary: Professor T conducts a series of lectures for his students detailing a high-profile court case in which a caretaker is accused of murdering his employer; the accused was found standing over the victim's body and his fingerprints on the murder weapon, but Professor T is convinced of his innocence, bringing him into conflict with the CID team and DI Paul Rabbits as the investigating officer. As Professor T persuades Lisa to go behind Paul's back and help him try to prove his case, he starts to shine a different light on the prosecution's evidence. Lisa tries to soften the blow to Dan of her upcoming promotion but only succeeds in making things worse. Adelaide agrees to Dr Helena's request to take part in a joint therapy session with her son to try to help him understand the root of his hostility towards women, but conflict ensues.

episodes.title: Swansong
episodes.summary: After discovering the body of an undercover police officer, the CID team blunder into a Drugs Squad operation against a major trafficker that appears to implicate one of their closest colleagues.

episodes.title: Heir to the Throne
episodes.summary: Professor T is banged up in prison awaiting trial.  He is not your typical inmate and the sights, sounds and smells of jail are difficult for him.  His police colleagues Dan and Lisa try to distract him with a murder case involving two brothers.

episodes.title: The Perfect Picture
episodes.summary: A bride is found dead in a hotel swimming pool on her wedding night. Despite the seemingly perfect wedding photos, foul play is suspected, and Professor T is brought in to assist with the investigation.

episodes.title: Truth and Justice
episodes.summary: Facing court, Professor T must make a critical decision between saving himself or a former lover. Meanwhile, a prison officer's death brings about a mystery with numerous suspects, one of whom seems particularly eager to take the blame.

episodes.title: A Little Drop of Poison
episodes.summary: Released from prison, Professor T is eager to return to his work at the university and assist the police. The team needs his expertise to solve a series of mysterious deaths before more lives are lost.

episodes.title: The Conference
episodes.summary: After a murder at a Criminology Conference implicates Professor T, especially since the victim was his major rival and successor at the university, he must clear his name to restore his reputation and reclaim his job.

episodes.title: Attachment Issues
episodes.summary: A woman is discovered dead at a car crash scene, but the accident appears not to have been the cause of her death. Professor T investigates the case and uncovers unsettling parallels to his own life.

episodes.title: Overboard
episodes.summary: Jasper is no longer consulting for the police. But when a woman disappears from a yacht, his therapist asks him to once again get involved.

episodes.title: September Gardens
episodes.summary: While Jasper visits a home for the elderly, a woman is killed by one of the people living there. But there may be more to the murder than meets the eye.

episodes.title: The Inspection
episodes.summary: A school inspector is killed, first by five stab wounds, and then by being smothered. Why two different methods?

episodes.title: You Can't Kill Me
episodes.summary: A stage prop knife is substituted by a real knife. Who did the switch and why?

episodes.title: The Perfect Murder
episodes.summary: When a painting is destroyed, suspicions fall on a group of climate activists. But the next attack leaves a dead body behind.

episodes.title: The Warrior Gene
episodes.summary: A man staggers in front of a car, and confesses to killing a man before dying. But where is the body?

episodes.title: Natural Causes
episodes.summary: Weeks after yielding to desire, Jasper and Helena test their new romance at a luxury hotel and spa. But two "natural" deaths rouse Jasper's suspicion, drawing him into an obsession that threatens their fragile bond. Meanwhile, Dan is pulled toward enigmatic Leonie, sensing a spark that might finally break the grip of his past.

episodes.title: The Ring
episodes.summary: After a charity boxing upset, champ Rhys Gibson is found bludgeoned to death, sparking a deadly fallout.  Back from her world trip, Adelaide collapses mid-flight leaving Jasper torn between the case and his mother's failing health, leaning on Helena for help. But guilt and grief weigh heavy. Dan's first date with Leonie takes an unexpected turn when her crime-boss father turns up.

episodes.title: Retreat
episodes.summary: A mysterious death at a spiritual retreat pulls Jasper into the orbit of the enigmatic Lady Cynthia, and the post-mortem shatters the guests' identical stories of an open and shut case. As tensions spike and a near-confession is abruptly cut short, Jasper's unresolved grief for Adelaide shadows his every move, heightening the pressure on both the case and his fragile bond with Helena.

episodes.title: Ghostwriter
episodes.summary: When Jasper's former mentor, Hamish Maclean, is murdered, a shaky arrest and twisting testimonies expose a deeper conspiracy. Drawn into a maze of old loyalties and buried deceit, Jasper uncovers a cunning plot that forces him to risk everything--including his own life--to unmask the killer. Meanwhile, Dan's bond with Leonie falters under her father's quiet sabotage.

episodes.title: Cipher
episodes.summary: As Jasper turns to tech to manage his spiralling OCD, the murder of a golf instructor and a taunting cipher ignite fears of a serial killer. A rare error from the Professor heightens tensions as the ciphers grow bolder. Meanwhile, Leonie's bond with her father, Chester, is pushed to breaking point by his deep-seated hatred of the police as Dan is caught between loyalty and duty.

episodes.title: The Things We Do for Love
episodes.summary: Dan's choice to expose CCTV evidence against Leonie's father jeopardizes their relationship and sparks dangerous reprisals. As tensions explode, a seemingly random Comic Con stabbing reveals a dark plot as Chloe races to unmask the killer. With Jasper and Helena ready to leave for America, Dan's shocking arrest for murder pulls the team into a finale where loyalty and love are pushed to the edge.
